newsitem.title: FINLAND: STATE-OWNED POSTIPANKKI NOT FOR SALE NOW - LIPPONEN.
newsitem.headline: STATE-OWNED POSTIPANKKI NOT FOR SALE NOW - LIPPONEN.

text.p: Finnish Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen said on Tuesday that state-owned commercial bank Postipankki Oy was not for sale now.
"Postipankki is not for sale now," Lipponen said on an internet question and answer session when asked via e-mail whether the state was planning on selling Postipankki (see http://www.vn.fi/).
On Monday, cooperative banking group OKOBANK CEO Antti Tanskanen was quoted as saying in regional daily Etela-Saimaa that his bank may consider buying Postipankki if it came up for sale.

Asked whether banks that are on the state's banking support programme can carry out management options schemes, Lipponen said: "Before banks start distributing additional incentives, it must be ensured that the state gets its share of bank support in line with agreed timetables."
Finland's largest banking group Merita Oy which has some 3.5 billion markka of state capital certificates plans an options scheme for its management.
